scope: Read-only independent review of the functional orchestrator and CLI capture against the frozen four-input v1 lock; review-only reference artifacts added.

tests.python_version: 3.10.17 | packaged by conda-forge | (main, Apr 10 2025, 22:06:35) [MSC v.1943 64 bit (AMD64)]

reviewed_properties: The complete canonical v1 selection is independently pinned; source-lock page membership, source/canonical/RGB hashes, model revision and all four model asset hashes are checked.

The capture records startup source bytes, Cargo release/locked command, target directory, compiler identities and environment overrides; it preserves the Cargo-emitted executable and rejects changed source at build completion.

The execution validates archived and current source closure, fresh same-binary expanded/unpacked sequential controls for all four inputs, exact min64/max1536/cap4096/four-thread FP32 AVX2 options, and the four joint layout modes.

Result validation rejects missing/extra requests, malformed IDs/counts/stops, tokens after EOS, replay markers, teacher forcing, wrong precision/backend/layout, malformed packing metadata and nonfinite timings. Literal text is not normalized.

Per-request order, IDs, text, finish reason, output/input counts and dimensions are compared with sequential controls. Mixed EOS completion, multiple requests eligible for decode and long-input coverage must be observed independently of exact output equality.
A native physical-memory availability check requires at least 12 GiB before every process. Plan and binary hashes are checked before launch.

Startup plan identity and saved JSONL, stderr, invocation, comparison and execution artifacts are rechecked before acceptance. Source/build/input closure and Python/binary identity are checked at completion.

A failed process, missing output, low memory, changed artifact or incomplete coverage cannot produce an accepted final execution receipt. Existing execution/output paths are not overwritten or resumed.
Timing fields are retained solely as diagnostics; the report does not aggregate timings, claim quiet conditions, promote a default or qualify quality/performance.
review_findings_resolved: Added missing CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS and CMAKE_GENERATOR capture metadata.
Pinned the complete canonical workload to prevent self-consistent selection/order substitutions.
Bound execution to the startup plan hash and rejected replay markers.
Added final raw-artifact closure and mutation tests for build/source/binary and late evidence changes.
limitations: No CLI build or inference was executed by this review, and no passing actual functional batch result is claimed.
Synthetic subprocesses and small synthetic archives exercise failure handling; they do not establish model arithmetic, OCR quality, allocation behavior, performance or peak memory.
Captured builds explicitly remain nonhermetic and may reuse Cargo/native dependency objects.
The 12 GiB preflight is an execution guard, not a memory-usage bound.
The v1 scope is one fixed batch of four; batches two/eight, reordered cases and other input mixtures are not qualified.
